_meta.rule: Translate every value. Keep labels concise enough for the existing whiteboard layout.

translations.《生产级多智能体系统》第 05 章架构图，使用确定性白板线框表达控制流、证据或责: Chapter 05 architecture diagram for Production-Grade Multi-Agent Systems, using deterministic whiteboard wireframes to show control flow, evidence, and responsibility boundaries.
translations.备份只有在恢复与业务不变量验证后才成立: A backup counts only after restore and business-invariant validation
translations.从进程启动到业务可用：五层健康合同: From process startup to business-ready: a five-layer health contract
translations.错误分类决定：重试、快速失败、降级、进 DLQ，还是人工升级。: Error classification determines whether to retry, fail fast, degrade, send to the DLQ, or escalate to a human.
translations.关键业务路径是否成功: Does the critical business path succeed?
translations.恢复点 · 耗时 · 版本集合 · 不变量 · 异常 · 审批: Recovery point · Duration · Version set · Invariants · Exceptions · Approvals
translations.计算实例可以替换；每一份持久状态都必须有唯一 Owner、SoT 和恢复路径。: Compute instances are replaceable; every persistent state must have one Owner, SoT, and recovery path.
translations.禁止：Secret · 原始 Prompt · PII · request_id: Forbidden: Secret · Raw Prompt · PII · request_id as Metric Label
translations.可靠性保护层：限制等待、放大与故障扩散: Reliability safeguards: limit waiting, amplification, and failure propagation
translations.每层回答不同问题，失败动作也不同；不能用一个 /health 端点含糊带过。: Each layer answers a different question and triggers a different failure action; one vague /health endpoint is not enough.
translations.每一层解决不同问题；最危险的反模式是多层无界重试和无限排队。: Each layer solves a different problem; the most dangerous anti-pattern is unbounded retries across layers and infinite queues.
translations.模型只负责局部判断；权限、状态、恢复与运营保证必须由确定性平台承担。: The model handles only local judgment; permissions, state, recovery, and operational guarantees belong to the deterministic platform.
translations.生产级 Agent 平台的五个平面: Five planes of a production-grade Agent platform
translations.实例重启 → 读取 Checkpoint → 校验版本 → 继续或安全停止: Instance restarts → Read Checkpoint → Validate version → Resume or stop safely
translations.数据库可连接只是开始；任务不重放、Artifact 对齐、索引同源、权限仍生效才: Database connectivity is only the beginning; success means tasks are not replayed, Artifacts align, indexes share the same source, and permissions remain enforced.
translations.同一运行信封约束因果链与时间预算；观测和恢复分别证明“发生了什么”与“能否回来”: One runtime envelope constrains the causal chain and time budget; observability proves “what happened,” while recovery proves “whether the system can recover.”
translations.外部依赖短暂故障不应让 Liveness 制造重启风暴。: Brief failures in external dependencies should not let Liveness trigger a restart storm.
translations.完整内容进入受控 Artifact；遥测只保存稳定属性、哈希和不可变引用。: Full content goes into a controlled Artifact; telemetry retains only stable attributes, hashes, and immutable references.
translations.一次 Agent 请求的可观测因果链: Observable causal chain for one Agent request
translations.责任可以部署在一起，但入口、决策、执行、状态与运营的所有权不能混在一起。: Responsibilities may be co-deployed, but ownership of ingress, decisions, execution, state, and operations must remain distinct.
translations.CaseOps Slice 4：运行保证必须可以被执行: CaseOps Slice 4: Operational guarantees must be enforceable
translations.Readiness：低成本检查硬依赖与版本；Synthetic：低频验证端到端业: Readiness: low-cost checks of hard dependencies and versions; Synthetic: low-frequency validation of end-to-end business invariants.
translations.RPO 约束恢复点，RTO 约束恢复时间；成功文件不等于成功恢复。: RPO constrains the recovery point; RTO constrains recovery time. A successful backup file does not mean successful recovery.
translations.Running ≠ Ready ≠ Recoverable：三个结论都要由可重复: Running ≠ Ready ≠ Recoverable: each conclusion requires repeatable acceptance evidence.
translations.SoT 丢失不能靠相似索引找回；派生索引丢失则必须能够从版本化源重建。: A lost SoT cannot be recovered from a similarity index; a lost derived index must be rebuildable from a versioned source.
translations.Trace 连接因果路径，Metric 聚合趋势，Log 解释事件；Baggag: Trace links the causal path, Metric aggregates trends, and Log explains events; Baggage propagates only controlled, low-sensitivity context.
